questions.stem: Why do muscle cells contain large numbers of mitochondria?

options.text: To store oxygen needed for contraction
To remove waste carbon dioxide from the muscle
To produce the large amounts of energy (ATP) needed for muscle contraction
To synthesise the proteins that make up muscle fibres

questions.explanation: Muscle cells require large amounts of energy to contract and relax. Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration to produce the ATP needed to power these constant contractions.
